description: List every Eased component (motion-first React components installed with the shadcn CLI) in catalogue order, with slug, title, one-line summary, tier (free or pro), interaction verb (Hover, Press, Drag, Slide, Select, Type, Loading, Scroll), the industries it suits and page URL. Use it to browse what exists, optionally for one industry (e.g. crypto, legal); use search_components to find one for a specific need.

industry.description: Only components tagged for this industry: ai (AI agents), devtools (developer tools), finance (fintech and FX), crypto (crypto), saas (SaaS analytics), legal (legal tech), ecommerce (e-commerce), real-estate (real estate and CRE), health (health tech), hr (HR and recruiting), education (edtech), travel (travel and booking), media (creator tools). Leave out for every industry.

tier.description: Only free (MIT, installable now) or only Pro components. Leave out for both.

name: list_components
title: List Eased components
